svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 03/12 Mission Bay (Rare)
svg.desc: The newer campus down by the water. Glass buildings, wide walks, and the bay right there. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
